jobs.title: Demande de bourse Game Changer 2026
jobs.description_text: Chez Kabam, nous croyons que le jeu vidéo est un savant mélange de créativité, de technologie et d'art. Nous souhaitons mettre en lumière la prochaine génération de concepteurs et d'artistes qui façonneront l'avenir de cette industrie. Grâce à cette bourse, nous visons à offrir une possibilité de soutien financier et à transformer votre passion en carrière… Nous sommes ravis d'offrir une bourse aux étudiants inscrits à un programme postsecondaire en art ou en design et qui souhaitent faire carrière dans l'industrie du jeu vidéo. Grâce à cette initiative, nous espérons apporter de nouvelles perspectives, de nouvelles idées et de nouvelles expériences à notre industrie. La bourse Game Changer de Kabam attribuera $5,000 CAD à la personne sélectionnée afin de soutenir son parcours scolaire. Mais c'est bien plus qu'une simple valeur monétaire. C'est un investissement dans votre potentiel, une reconnaissance de votre passion et un tremplin pour devenir un chef de file de l'industrie du jeu vidéo. Nous recherchons des personnes qui incarnent l'esprit d'innovation et de collaboration qui caractérise la culture de Kabam. L'étudiant idéal n'est pas seulement passionné par les jeux vidéo, mais est également profondément déterminé à faire une différence dans l'industrie. Si vous êtes motivé, créatif et désireux d'apporter votre perspective unique au monde du jeu vidéo, nous voulons connaître votre histoire! Dans votre candidature, parlez-nous de votre parcours, de vos rêves et des raison

jobs.title: Manager/Senior Manager, CMC Quality Control
jobs.description_text: Role Summary The Manager/Senior Manager, CMC Quality Control (QC) is responsible for providing strategic and operational oversight of QC activities supporting Lexeo's gene therapy programs. This role serves as a QC lead for external contract testing laboratories (CTLs), analytical lifecycle management (i.e., late-phase method validation), stability programs, release testing support, and analytical investigation activities. The individual will work closely with Analytical Development, Technical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, and external partners to ensure analytical methods, specifications, and testing programs support clinical development, process validation readiness, and future commercial requirements. This position requires technical expertise in analytical testing, preferably of AAV-based products, as well as demonstrated experience overseeing external laboratories and driving cross-functional CMC initiatives. Compensation is dependent on qualifications and experience

jobs.title: Scientist II, Analytical Development
jobs.description_text: Role Summary This Scientist II will independently design, execute, and analyze research studies and will drive one or more analytical development projects for AAV-based gene therapy programs. The role provides technical leadership in the development, optimization, qualification, validation, and transfer of analytical assays, including cell-based potency and molecular methods such as qPCR and ddPCR. The Scientist II will apply broad scientific knowledge and novel approaches to establish AAV mechanisms of action in cellular systems, resolve moderately complex technical issues, and support GMP manufacturing, material release, and regulatory submissions in collaboration with groups across CMC, Quality, QC, and external partners. The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, detail-oriented, able to manage multiple priorities, and effective in a fast-paced environment. The Scientist II is expected to exercise sound scientific judgment, communicate complex technical issues clearly, build alignment across functions, and serve as a technical resource to colleagues. This is a highly visible and impactful role in our CMC organization. Compensation is dependent on qualifications and experrience

jobs.description_text: Team Description: Kitware, Inc. is actively seeking Computer Vision Co-Op Interns to join our Computer Vision Team at our Clifton Park, NY headquarters. jobs.title: Physics-Based Modeling Research Internship
jobs.description_text: Team Description: Kitware is seeking a Physics-Based Modeling Research Intern to join the Computer Vision team. In this role, you'll develop computational models of biological systems that support cutting-edge research in medical imaging, biomechanics, physiology, and digital health. You'll work closely with software developers, AI researchers, clinicians, and domain scientists to create validated models that answer challenging scientific and clinical questions. About the Projects: Kitware’s employees have unique opportunities to interact and collaborate directly with customers, visit interesting customer sites, and participate in live field tests and demonstrations. Much of Kitware’s work involves applying state-of-the-art artificial intelligence and mechanistic modeling approaches to dynamic, real-world problems. We consider the work that we do on our government contracts as one of the ways that we give back to the community. We partner with premier government R&D agencies such as DARPA, IARPA, ARPA-H, DHA, AFRL, Army C5ISR, NOAA, and other branches of the US Government on a range of efforts, including prime contracts, SBIRs, and STTRs. In addition, we provide commercial services to companies ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. Kitware employs an open source business model to foster extended, collaborative communities and to provide effective, flexible, and high-quality technical solutions.

jobs.description_text: Take ownership of complex accounting work - and help us improve how we do it. At Kitware, we're looking for an experienced accounting professional who wants to do more than maintain the books. As our Senior Accountant, you'll play an important role in maintaining financial accuracy and regulatory compliance while helping us strengthen the processes and policies that support a growing R&D software company. This role offers a mix of hands-on accounting, multi-state tax compliance, technical research, and process improvement. You'll have the independence to research complex accounting and tax issues, recommend solutions, and turn evolving requirements into practical processes that work for the business. You'll also develop a broader understanding of Kitware's finance operations, giving you the opportunity to collaborate across functions and contribute beyond your primary responsibilities. Prepare and file state and local tax filings, including sales and use tax, gross receipts tax, and other indirect taxes across multiple jurisdictions - currently 28 states. Conduct technical accounting and tax research to ensure compliance with evolving state regulations and government requirements. jobs.description_text: Octopus Centre for Heating Technology is the hardware division of the Octopus Energy Group, one of the UK's leading energy suppliers. Based in Portadown, we develop and manufacture the air source heat pumps and associated hardware that Octopus Energy installs in homes across the country. You’ll set the technical direction for R&D, manage a team of engineers and technicians, and work closely with product, commercial and manufacturing colleagues to bring new products to market.

jobs.title: Regional Field Manager, Kansas - Overland Park
jobs.description_text: Americans for Prosperity (AFP) is the premier grassroots organization focused on advocating solutions to the country’s greatest challenges. We recognize that tens of millions of Americans are frustrated with the extreme partisanship in government that keeps common-sense reforms from being passed, and instead seek to stand with policy leaders who are committed to finding a better way. Americans for Prosperity is part of the Stand Together philanthropic community. This role will be based in Overland Park and the Johnson County, Kansas region. As a Regional Field Manager on our Americans for Prosperity-Kansas team you will identify, recruit, and engage grassroots leaders in Kansas, mobilize them to take action, and drive policy reform that opens opportunities for all. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $50,000–$65,000 per year. This role may also be eligible for additional bonus compensation designed to align total compensation with an employee’s overall contribution to the organization. Our Principles-Based Management™ (PBM) compensation philosophy is grounded in an individualized approach that rewards the long-term value each person creates for the organization. Compensation decisions are informed by a variety of factors, including relevant experience, capabilities, demonstrated skills, role responsibilities, and expected contribution. Consistent with this approach, base salary may vary within or outside of the anticipated range based on these considerations.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Program Management Office
jobs.description_text: Position Summary The Senior Manager, Project Management Office (PMO) reports to the Director of Mission Assurance and Program Integration and is responsible for leading enterprise program governance, integrated schedule and budget planning, program controls, portfolio reporting, and cross-segment coordination for complex telecommunications and space programs. This role provides the framework, tools, processes, and oversight necessary to enable successful program delivery across multiple organizational segments while ensuring executive leadership has clear visibility into program performance, risks, dependencies, milestones, and strategic objectives. The Senior Manager, PMO has a staff who serve as the central integrators across engineering, operations, supply chain, finance, mission assurance, product management, and other stakeholder organizations supporting multiple projects. The position does not directly manage segment Program Managers, who remain within their respective organizations and coordinate extensively with the PMO, However, the role establishes program management standards, methodologies, reporting requirements, and governance practices across the enterprise. The successful candidate must be comfortable operating in an evolving environment where not all processes, standards, and organizational interfaces have been fully established, and where success requires building structure, alignment, and operational discipline across multiple stakeholders.

Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences music and strengthen Spotify’s role as a trusted, culturally relevant voice in the music landscape.

jobs.title: Tax Analyst
jobs.description_text: We are currently looking for a new band member to join the Spotify Tax Team. This new band member will be an Analyst, joining the Global Indirect Tax Team. This position will report into the Senior Manager for Indirect Tax in EMEA and APAC and will be based in Stockholm, Sweden. In your role, you will focus on compliance and reporting. Spotify reports indirect taxes in more than 90 countries globally and you will be a key member of the team responsible for ensuring the completeness, timeliness and accuracy of Spotify’s global indirect tax compliance obligations. You will work in close collaboration with global tax team members in both Stockholm and New York, and work cross functionally with various accounting and finance teams. We are a team of highly skilled and dedicated colleagues and we offer a challenging and dynamic role in an ever changing environment with the opportunity to take on much responsibility in a rapidly growing international company. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences audio.

jobs.title: Partner Success Manager, China & APAC
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Partner Success Manager to join the Xsolla Partner Network (XPN) Business Development team, based in China. This is a newly created, hybrid role sitting within the core XPN BD team — roughly 80% campaign and partner success, 20% business development support — created to close a gap in how XPN partners are supported once a deal closes: campaigns are launched, but no one consistently owns their ongoing success. The best candidate will be someone comfortable owning outcomes rather than just relationships — proactively strategizing with partners, coordinating across internal teams to get campaigns right, and stepping in to help close deals when local presence and trust matter more than a remote pitch. Full ownership of the sales process (sourcing, pitching, commercial negotiation) sits with the Core China/APAC Team; this role isn't required to run a deal end-to-end, but is expected to help get opportunities over the line and make sure they deliver once signed. If you're excited about building a new function from the ground up, becoming a product expert partners and internal teams rely on, and working across both Chinese and global creator platforms as publishers look to expand their reach, we would love to hear from you! Ce poste est axé sur la planification financière, la modélisation des réponses aux appels d'offres et l'analyse stratégique. Le candidat idéal possédera une solide expertise en modélisation financière, un grand souci du détail, un esprit d'initiative et une capacité à évoluer efficacement dans un contexte d'incertitude. Doté d'une mentalité d'amélioration continue, il contribuera à la prise de décisions stratégiques chez Lyft.
